title: Beautiful Danxia - Flute 2 Syncopation Loop (Bars 27–28)

goals.goal: Lock into 8th/16th subdivision clicks and anchor syncopations without rushing bar 28.
goals.teacherNote: Rehearsal focus: Previous diagnostic showed woodwinds rushing the syncopations in bar 28. Use 8th-note or 16th-note subdivision clicks.

teacherGeneralNotes: Band Director assignment: Practice with the ensemble backing. Mute your part using Minus-One mode and record your official take when ready.
